title: Command-line agents
summary: JayV does not write code by itself: it orchestrates the coding agents you already use — Codex, Claude Code, GitHub Copilot and Cursor Agent — running each one's own command line on your computer.
usage: Open Settings, turn on the agents installed on this computer and list the models each one may use. Each CLI keeps its own login; no key or password passes through JayV. The System page shows whether each agent is installed and answering.
